description: Add explicit source-channel/grouping persistence and atomic lookup so inbound and PersistMessageHistory use the Channels identity. Action reuse: extend Engine Conversations and existing PersistMessageHistory Action; no parallel helper/tool exposure. Contract: identity inputs from stamped Incoming only; create/reuse scoped active conversations; no wildcard null config; legacy mixed rows remain readable but are excluded from new scoped lookup; concurrency safe. Tests first for reuse/isolation, collision dimensions, concurrent create, explicit ID validation, outbound path.
title: [zaq-354.2] Channel-scoped conversation persistence
